ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What part passes food to the stomach?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the human digestive system. The oral cavity and throat region of the head are connected downward to a long thin tube; this tube extends downward along the neck and chest and connects to the stomach; there is a label O near this long tube in the figure. Reasoning: The question asks, “What part carries food to the stomach?” In the digestive system, the tube through which swallowed food passes from the mouth/throat into the stomach is called the esophagus, namely esophagus. Therefore the answer is the esophagus.
